title: Turn off SSH password and root login

steps.say: From your workstation: prove a key login works before turning passwords off.
Create this file. sshd uses the FIRST value it reads, and reads sshd_config.d files in name order, so 01- wins over 50-cloud-init.conf.
steps.rollback: Delete the file and restart ssh:
steps.content:
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no

steps.say: Test the config. No output means it is valid.
Restart SSH. Logged-in sessions stay connected.
steps.rollback: Remove the file again, then restart ssh.

steps.say: From your workstation, in a NEW terminal: log in again before closing the old session.

pitfalls: Keep your current session open until a new login works.
The service is called ssh on Ubuntu, not sshd.
